selection_rule: Maximize dev Evidence Hit@3, then dev Hit@1, then fewer stored characters; exact tie prefers C, B, A. No test-based tuning.
coherence_sampling: First ten source_id values sorted lexicographically; anchor is midpoint character of first prose paragraph of at least 150 characters. Inspect the earliest-start chunk covering that anchor.
query_language: English, matching the English technical corpus; report is Vietnamese.
